description: This file defines API endpoints related to products and categories in an application built using FastAPI framework. It handles listing categories, listing products with filtering, pagination, and sorting, and retrieving a product by ID or slug.

methods.name: list_categories(db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep))
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve all product categories.

methods.name: list_products( db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep), params=Depends(pagination_params), q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search query"), category: Optional[int] = Query(None, description="Category ID filter"), sort: Optional[str] = Query("latest", description="Sort by: latest|price_asc|price_desc"), )
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a paginated, filtered, and sorted list of products.

methods.name: get_product(id_or_slug: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep))
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a specific product by its ID or slug.

search-terms: product retrieval by ID or slug
